name: An Underrated Talent
label: Quest
description: An Underrated Talent: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.
I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you in need of a blade, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Interesting. I don't think anyone has ever asked me to actually carry out a custom commission for them. Mostly I just make humble, functional weapons in my own style. It's not much, but it's honest work and I don't seek accolades or glory.
I'm happy to try, but why would you seek me for this? There are plenty of smiths in the Undercity that will take on custom jobs like this.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
